climb.text: Add a subtract(a, b) function to src/calc.py that returns a minus b, with a unit test.
Make add(a, b) in src/calc.py raise a TypeError when either argument is not a number, with a unit test.
Add a divide(a, b) function to src/calc.py that returns a divided by b and raises ZeroDivisionError with the message "cannot divide by zero" when b is 0, with tests.
Rename src/calc.py to src/arith.py and update the tests to import from the new module.
Add a --sep flag to the slug command that sets the separator placed between words (default "-"), with a test.
Slugify("Hello  World") returns "hello--world": repeated spaces should give a single hyphen. Fix it and add a test.
Add a Truncate(s string, n int) string function to the text package that shortens a slug to at most n characters without leaving a trailing hyphen, with a test.
Make formatPrice in src/price.js group thousands with commas, so 123456 cents prints as $1,234.56, with a test.
Make formatPrice in src/price.js throw a RangeError for negative amounts, with a test.
Add a parsePrice(text) function to src/price.js that turns "$1.23" into 123 cents and returns null for text it cannot read, with a test.

held.text: Add a mean(values) function to src/calc.py that returns the average of a list of numbers and raises ValueError for an empty list, with a unit test.
Make the slug command print "slug: no input" to stderr and exit with status 2 when it gets no arguments, with a test.
Rename Slugify in the text package to Slug and update every caller and test.
Add a --currency option to bin/price.js that accepts USD or EUR (default USD); with EUR the amount is printed with a € sign instead of $, with a test.
formatPrice(5) prints $0.5 instead of $0.05. Fix it and add a test.
